approval.scope: Four revised parchment dialogue frame concepts: Japan bamboo, Yomi fire, Heaven gilded angel, Shadow demonic

reference: Approved four-frame concept board shown in the conversation
constraints: No embedded text, labels, buttons or characters
Transparent native RGBA exterior; original generated bytes preserved
Pale low-detail parchment for dark dialogue text
No attack timing, hitboxes or gameplay geometry changes
integrationNotes: Render preserving each native aspect ratio; do not stretch the decorative frame horizontally.
Safe text rectangles are conservative registration hints, not a mandatory fixed pixel UI box.
The center retains the generator's native near-opaque alpha (approximately250..254/255); keep text on the pale parchment and use measured contrast.
Some alpha<16 dust reaches the canvas boundary. Main visible ornament silhouettes have complete margins; use visibleBoundsAlpha16 for visual registration.
At880CSSpx wide, the native frame is about400CSSpx tall. The conservative safe rectangle has187..208CSSpx height; use pagination and/or natural text flow, never place content over ornament ends.
Integrator must verify actual browser readability at1280x720 and larger, keyboard focus, zoom and reduced-motion pause behavior.

assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Production bitmap UI asset for the detailed painted Japanese fantasy game Kiba Realms. Input reference is the USER APPROVED concept board, not an edit target. Create ONLY ONE wide horizontal empty dialogue parchment frame from the designated quadrant, isolated on TRUE TRANSPARENT alpha background. Image aspect ratio exactly 2.2:1, canvas 1760x800 or proportional landscape. This is substantially taller than 3:1: a wide but tall scroll. Frame fills most width with generous transparent margin for all decorations. Front-on orthographic, fully unrolled Japanese parchment scroll, vertical rolled ends and slim horizontal edge. All ends, tassels, flames, horns, ornaments must fit uncropped. Center paper fully opaque, pale, quiet, evenly lit with very faint natural fibers, optimized for dark UI text; clear usable rectangle from x15% to85% and y18% to82% of canvas. No letters, glyphs, symbols, text, buttons, characters, vignette, scene, backdrop, drop shadow rectangle, checkerboard or opaque surrounding background. Preserve detailed premium painted illustration material quality of reference. This is the final production frame, not a concept sheet, no grids or labels. Use ONLY top-left JAPAN bamboo scroll design from reference. Deep green bamboo horizontal bars and rolled ends, red binding knots and tassels, restrained white cherry blossom clusters and green leaves confined to edges. Warm ivory parchment. Balanced full silhouette. Quiet center.
CRITICAL PRODUCTION CORRECTION: retain the approved style, but make the central parchment rectangle tall, occupying at least 65% of the entire canvas height. The canvas aspect is 2.2:1, NOT3:1. Keep ornaments comparatively narrow at top and bottom. Leave at least 4% transparent margin on every outer side, especially above all fire, feathers and horns and below tassels. Nothing touches any canvas edge. Main parchment edges lie at y16% and84% canvas, producing large vertically usable inner paper. Side rolled ends x6%..14% and86%..94%; thin top/bottom bars, no broad horizontal ornament encroaching on paper. No text.
